assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness accompanied by a recent history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic etiologies contributing to these neurological and vestibular symptoms.
The procedure is Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229).
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197.
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
Coverage for this diagnostic procedure mandates advance approval to ensure medical necessity and compliance with plan guidelines.
Advance approval for this diagnostic procedure is warranted to ensure medical necessity and compliance with plan guidelines.
The patient has a recent history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
